scope: Every Stage 3 file read; gzip bodies decompressed; JSON recursively inspected; public fixture provenance and content categories reviewed
necessity: Preserve raw SEC evidence, compact frozen inputs, canonical output and existing source/test behavior
redundancy: Four duplicate/reconstructible exports excluded; small request plans retained to preserve selection chronology

privacy.secret_patterns: No hits for private keys, credential URLs, token shapes or assigned secrets
privacy.private_information: No private project/user contact data or private portfolio identity found; no identifying club name sought
privacy.public_information: SEC issuer business addresses/phones, officers and signatures retained as public source evidence
privacy.machine_metadata: No absolute local filesystem paths found; relative provenance paths, stable internal research IDs, source hashes and snapshot/retrieval clocks retained

excluded.name: .fetch.lock
excluded.reason: Transient zero-byte fetch lock; not research evidence

excluded.name: offline_tests.log
excluded.reason: Transient test output; validation summaries retained
